title: Renewable Energy Research Clusters
passage: European technological institutes have heavily invested in specialized solar and wind testing centers. Funding stems from both European Union competitive innovation grants and regional clean-technology consortiums. While solar cell efficiency has improved steadily in laboratory trials, commercial viability depends on battery storage scalability. Critics argue that grid integration costs are understated in government transition timelines, whereas proponents emphasize long-term environmental dividends.
